settings.label: Maximum items in a cart
settings.description: How many distinct products one cart may hold.

settings.label: Enable coupon codes
settings.description: Whether shoppers can apply a coupon at checkout.

settings.label: Enable gift codes
settings.description: Whether shoppers can redeem a gift code for store credit.

settings.label: Allow gifting from the chest
settings.description: Whether a member may hand an unclaimed item to somebody else. A product can still refuse on its own.

settings.label: Pay the difference when upgrading
settings.description: Somebody who already owns a cheaper product on the same shelf pays only the difference for a dearer one. Turn it off to charge the full price every time.

settings.label: Price of one credit
settings.description: What a shopper pays for a single credit, in the site currency. Every site sold credits at exactly 0.01 before this could be set.

settings.label: Default creator-code discount (%)
settings.description: Applied to a new creator code that does not name its own discount.

settings.label: Default creator-code commission (%)
settings.description: The creator's cut of an order that used their code, when the code does not name its own.

settings.label: Say "only N left" at
settings.description: A limited product says how few are left once it drops to this many. Zero says nothing at all.

settings.label: Tax rate (%)
settings.description: Zero switches tax off entirely. Applied after any discount.

settings.label: Prices already include tax
settings.description: On, the price shown is what the customer pays and the tax is the part of it the invoice names. Off, the tax is added at checkout.
